title: Product launch
goal: Show coordinated engineering, marketing, and enablement tracks ending at a launch milestone.

rubric.must: Release approval visibly waits for both security review and user acceptance testing.
Public launch visibly follows a go/no-go review that waits for release approval, communications, and support training.
The visible marketing track runs from positioning through campaign assets to launch communications.
The visible engineering track runs from scope through release candidate, security review, testing, and approval.
Kickoff, release approval, go/no-go review, and public launch are visibly distinguished as milestones.
A critical path is visibly highlighted across the longest schedule chain.
